findings.description: [00-desk-light.png & 01-desk-dark.png — Now SVG] Bottom 4-cell stat row overflows cell borders: 'CURRENT STREAK' and 'LONGEST STREAK' labels visibly cross their right cell borders (and 'CONTRIBUTIONS' nearly touches its right border) due to uppercase label width/letter-spacing exceeding the narrow 4-column cell width.

[00-desk-light.png & 01-desk-dark.png — Now SVG] Vertical text collision in 'DECLARED FOCUS' panel: the first bullet '• my-web-2026' sits practically touching the bottom of the 'DECLARED FOCUS' header with ~0px vertical gap, unlike the breathing room in 'GITHUB ACTIVITY' and 'DISCORD'.

[00-desk-light.png & 01-desk-dark.png — GitHub activity SVG] Inner-panel text overflow: at the bottom of 'EVENTS BY REPOSITORY', '8 private repos · 1,490 commits · 548 PRs (aggregated)' crosses past the right vertical border of the left inner box.

[02-mob-light.png & 03-mob-dark.png — Mobile legibility] Scaling the dense 840px 2-column 'GitHub activity' SVG down to ~358px (~0.43x) renders repo names, event counts, footer note, and JST timestamps unreadably tiny (~4–5.5px effective height) without pinch-zooming; secondary timestamps and sublabels in 'Now' ('observed...', 'all time', 'days') are similarly tiny.

[00-desk-light.png & 01-desk-dark.png — GitHub activity SVG] Asymmetrical left padding and row crowding: the 'EVENTS BY REPOSITORY' inner box is indented ~20px further inward than the 'GitHub activity' title and 'observed...' footer (unlike 'RECENT ACTIVITY' on the right), and each repo row's green bar sits directly on top of the next row's small branch icon.

[00-desk-light.png & 01-desk-dark.png — Status intuitiveness & copy truncation] In 'Now', 'presence data is stale or una...' truncates mid-word. In 'GitHub activity', 'RECENT ACTIVITY' truncates 'tastile-root · Issue...' before the issue number despite wide empty horizontal space before the timestamp, repeats identical PR lines ('herdr-t3 · PR #157' x2, 'tastile-root · PR #159' x2) without action verbs, and pairs a huge '4,364 commits' headline with event-count bars ('20 events').

[All images — Cross-asset consistency & light/dark polish] 'Selected work' still frame has sharp 90-degree corners while 'Now' and 'GitHub activity' SVGs have rounded corners; 'Now' uses an all-caps title + blue panel headers while 'GitHub activity' repeats the markdown H2 title verbatim in sentence case with dot-prefixed gray headers; dark SVGs have very subtle edges against dark mode (#0d1117) and would benefit from a subtle 1px border. On mobile, 'Stack' wraps 'Languages' into 7+7+1 leaving a single orphan 'p5*' icon.

[Per-image & Requirement Summary] 00-desk-light.png: Strong top hierarchy (Selected work leads), aligned 800px card edges, no white-card clash, clean light Stack icons; marred by Now/Activity text overflows and sharp vs rounded card corners. 01-desk-dark.png: Dark SVGs blend naturally with dark theme and Stack swaps cleanly to dark icons; same SVG overflow/collision/indent defects apply. 02-mob-light.png: Zero horizontal overflow and clean vertical rhythm, but GitHub activity body/timestamps are unreadably tiny at 390px. 03-mob-dark.png: Same mobile micro-text illegibility in GitHub activity and tiny metadata in Now; Stack dark icons read well. Verdicts — 1. Information hierarchy: MET; 2. Status intuitiveness: PARTIAL; 3. Consistency: PARTIAL; 4. Mobile: PARTIAL; 5. Light/dark: MET; 6. Composition: PARTIAL.

verdict.summary:
Overall verdict: ACCEPT WITH FIXES. The redesign is a major step forward over the rejected iteration: the page leads cleanly with Selected work, all three main visual blocks align at 800px with no white-card clash, Stack adapts cleanly to light/dark themes, and the redesigned 800x512 /now bento layout (live status on top, compact 4-stat footer at bottom) reads as one coherent card. However, concrete SVG text-overflow/collision defects ('CURRENT STREAK'/'LONGEST STREAK' crossing cell borders, 'DECLARED FOCUS' touching '• my-web-2026', and '(aggregated)' crossing the inner panel border in GitHub activity) plus unreadable mobile micro-text in the 840px GitHub activity SVG prevent a clean accept.

Requirement verdicts:
1. Information hierarchy: MET
2. Status intuitiveness: PARTIAL
3. Consistency: PARTIAL
4. Mobile: PARTIAL
5. Light/dark: MET
6. Composition: PARTIAL

Top 3 fixes by impact:
1. Fix SVG text clipping and vertical collisions: reduce label font-size/letter-spacing or shorten 'CURRENT STREAK'/'LONGEST STREAK' so labels fit comfortably inside the 4-cell footer; add ~10–12px spacing between 'DECLARED FOCUS' and '• my-web-2026'; shorten or wrap '8 private repos · 1,490 commits · 548 PRs (aggregated)' so it stays inside the left inner box; increase repo row vertical spacing so green bars clear the next row's icon; remove mid-word truncation in 'presence data is stale or una...'.
2. Improve mobile legibility of the GitHub activity SVG (and secondary /now metadata): at 390px (~0.43x scale), the 840px 2-column dashboard shrinks body text and JST timestamps below readable size; use a narrower viewBox or larger base type with tighter copy so mobile text stays legible without pinch-zooming.
3. Fix internal alignment and feed polish: align the left edge of 'EVENTS BY REPOSITORY' with the 'GitHub activity' header/footer margin; widen truncation limits in 'RECENT ACTIVITY' so 'tastile-root · Issue #...' fits in the unused horizontal gap and distinguish duplicate PR events with action labels; optionally round 'Selected work' corners and add a subtle 1px border to the dark SVGs for consistent framing across light and dark modes.
